feedbackItems.quote: I submitted photos a week ago but the app still just says 'Under Review'. I don't know if you're waiting on me or the garage.
47% of repeat calls on open motor claims ask only for status — no new information from the customer.
Brokers want a single line they can read to customers: what stage the claim is in and what happens next.
Reviews mention 'no idea when payout will happen' more often than complaint about outcome.
Customers miss requests for police ref or extra photos because we email once; app doesn't surface 'action needed'.

duplicateProblemStatement: Multiple feedback items describe the same gap: passive 'Under Review' with no stage, next action, or ETA — not separate feature requests.
